pick.headline: British hostage Jack Mann freed in Lebanon

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 185, 24 September 1991
evidence.snippet: …O Promises To Free Hostage Within ‘48 Hours’ NC240905 1091 Beirut Voice of Lebanon in Arabic 0315 GMT 24 Sep 91 [Text] The Revolutionary Justice Organization [RJO} has announced that it will release British hostage Jack Mann in the next 48 hours due to the success of the UN secretary general's efforts. In a statement accompanied by a photograph of American hostage Joseph Cicippio, the organization thanked Iran and Syria for their coop- erat…
